🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: sector breadth ≥7/11 and cyclicals showing strength with Financials and Industrials packing multiple ABOVE TREND names (JPM (1W: +1.06% | 1M: +10.64%) ABOVE TREND; CAT (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +16.16%) ABOVE TREND). Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology in Top 5) — watch concentration.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leading: SHOP (1W: +17.54% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +11.39% | 1M: +33.95%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary strong: TSLA (1W: +11.37% | 1M: +3.21%) ABOVE TREND, BKNG (1W: +8.34% | 1M: +11.79%) ABOVE TREND. Financials constructive: JPM (1W: +1.06% | 1M: +10.64%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +1.47% | 1M: +4.75%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy weak: CVX (1W: -4.45% | 1M: -9.03%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -3.25% | 1M: -6.63%) BELOW TREND. Utilities lag: sector negative on 1W. Healthcare mixed/soft: JNJ (1W: -3.06% | 1M: -2.91%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -1.04% | 1M: +0.26%) CORRECTION.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: SHOP (1W: +17.54% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND; ORCL (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND; NOW (1W: +11.97% | 1M: -11.96%) RECOVERY; AMD (1W: +11.39% | 1M: +33.95%) ABOVE TREND; TSLA (1W: +11.37% | 1M: +3.21%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — concentration risk despite broad regime.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CVX (1W: -4.45% | 1M: -9.03%) BELOW TREND; EOG (1W: -4.96% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND; MPC (1W: -4.96% | 1M: -9.19%) BELOW TREND; WFC (1W: -5.39% | 1M: +7.30%) CORRECTION; COP (1W: -5.80% | 1M: -7.59%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Energy.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: SHOP (1W: +17.54% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +11.97% | 1M: -11.96%) RECOVERY, AMD (1W: +11.39% | 1M: +33.95%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +11.37% | 1M: +3.21%) ABOVE TREND. Note short-term reversals among NOW, PLTR (1W: +10.21% | 1M: -6.29%) RECOVERY and INTU (1W: +9.58% | 1M: -10.80%) RECOVERY — tactical bounces, not regime breaks.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology: 1W: +6.31% | 1M: +8.92% (24 stocks) — strong but leadership concentrated. Big names ABOVE TREND: AAPL (1W: +5.34% | 1M: +9.68%) ABOVE TREND; MSFT (1W: +8.77% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND; NVDA (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +13.16%) ABOVE TREND; several mid-cap techs in RECOVERY (NOW, PLTR, INTU) indicating short-term rotation within the sector.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials: 1W: +1.94% | 1M: +11.11% (20 stocks) — constructive and confirming RISK-ON. Leaders ABOVE TREND: JPM (1W: +1.06% | 1M: +10.64%) ABOVE TREND; V (1W: +1.47% | 1M: +4.75%) ABOVE TREND; MA (1W: +1.59% | 1M: +5.37%) ABOVE TREND. Watch WFC (1W: -5.39% | 1M: +7.30%) CORRECTION for idiosyncratic legal/news risk.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare: 1W: -0.83% | 1M: +1.38% (17 stocks) — mixed, defensive names not leading. UNH (1W: +3.35% | 1M: +15.35%) ABOVE TREND is a standout while JNJ (1W: -3.06% | 1M: -2.91%) BELOW TREND shows sector bifurcation; LLY (1W: -1.04% | 1M: +0.26%) CORRECTION reflects headline-driven swings.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Financials and selective Technology names (JPM (1W: +1.06% | 1M: +10.64%) ABOVE TREND; NVDA (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +13.16%) ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to Energy and Utilities given consistent BELOW TREND readings. Style: Growth/Momentum leadership from Tech but with Value/Cyclical participation — be selective due to narrow leadership.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: SHOP (1W: +17.54% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +18.93%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CVX (1W: -4.45% | 1M: -9.03%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -3.25% | 1M: -6.63%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -8.07% | 1M: +3.37%) CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +6.31% | 1M: +8.92%) and Financials (1W: +1.94% | 1M: +11.11%) — monitor breadth. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -6.15%) and Utilities (1W: -1.41% | 1M: -1.72%) remain weak.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA 900 resistance — ABOVE TREND continuation would confirm further upside; AAPL 180 support — hold would sustain tech leadership; JPM 200 breakout would signal Financials extension; CVX failing near-term support would deepen Energy BELOW TREND pressure.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
AMZN (+55): Amazon expected to report a strong quarter on AI/Claude demand; AMZN (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +18.93%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming price. UNH (+55): Jefferies raises UNH target; UNH (1W: +3.35% | 1M: +15.35%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming strength. LMT (+60): $11.9B Germany deal headline; LMT (1W: -6.20% | 1M: -8.82%) BELOW TREND — bullish news but price diverging, watch for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
WFC (-55): Muni bond case headline; WFC (1W: -5.39% | 1M: +7.30%) CORRECTION — bearish news aligns with short-term weakness, monitor. NFLX (-45): subscriber concerns headline; NFLX (1W: -8.07% | 1M: +3.37%) CORRECTION — price reacting faster than monthly trend. UNH (-60): Medicare hit headline; UNH (1W: +3.35% | 1M: +15.35%) ABOVE TREND — large news divergence, watch for earnings/clarity.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Growth/Momentum style with breadth confirming the move (Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive). NVDA (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +13.16%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +5.34% | 1M: +9.68%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +1.06% | 1M: +10.64%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow leadership (Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology)) and headline divergences (LMT positive news vs BELOW TREND price; UNH mixed sentiment) that could produce short-term rotation.
